usage:
  morphic validate <spec-file> [flags]

Check an API spec (OpenAPI 3.x) and write its diagnostics to stderr, writing
no IR anywhere. validate is compile's pipeline with the document dropped
instead of marshalled, for a gate that wants the diagnostics and the exit
code and would throw the document away.

The diagnostics and the exit code are compile's: 0 when nothing reaches
--fail-on, 1 when something does or the spec lowered to no document at all,
2 for a misuse or an I/O error.

--skip-validate and --disable-pass validate are interchangeable. Both name the
referential-integrity pass, not this command: they drop that pass's
diagnostics and keep the compiler's.

--opt is compile's, and takes the same settings: a spec that needs one to
compile needs it here too, or what is checked is not what would be built.

flags:
  -disable-pass value
    	disable the named IR pass (repeatable)
  -fail-on string
    	fail (exit 1) on diagnostics at or above this severity: error|warning (default "error")
  -opt key=value
    	set one key=value option on the compiler the spec selects (repeatable)
  -skip-validate
    	alias for --disable-pass validate
